svg.title: The map: 178 wines, three clusters, two axes
svg.desc: A scatter of 178 wines placed by their first two principal components. Sixty-two are squares on the right, fifty-one are triangles on the upper left and sixty-five are circles at the bottom, and the three cluster centres are marked with crosses at minus 0.04 and minus 1.77, minus 2.72 and 1.13, and 2.28 and 0.93. The axes are labelled PC1 36.2 per cent and PC2 19.2 per cent, and a note records that 36.2 plus 19.2 is 55.4, so 44.6 per cent of the spread is not on the page at all.
svg.text: Three groups, drawn on two axes.
